Cara Nguyen: FYI customer hit a 422 on /v1/rerank, says scores are all 0 and payload rejected. payload they sent below. can someone triage?
Mohammed Ali: paste the raw payload and the exact error body pls.
Cara Nguyen: error: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity: \"Invalid input: 'candidates' expected array of strings or objects with 'text' field, found nested 'documents'\". payload: ```{
  \"query\": { \"text\": \"find relevant policies about data retention\" },
  \"documents\": [
    {\"id\": \"d1\", \"passages\": [{\"text\": \"retention period is 90 days\"}]},
    {\"id\": \"d2\", \"passages\": [{\"text\": \"retain logs for 1 year\"}]}
  ],
  \"candidates\": [
    {\"id\": \"c1\", \"text\": \"90 days retention\"},
    {\"id\": \"c2\", \"text\": \"1 year logs\"}
  ]
}```
Cara Nguyen: they were trying both documents+passages and candidates in same payload to get passage-level reranking.
Eli Torres: aha, current rerank schema allows TWO distinct modes: - candidates mode (top-level \"query\" as string, \"candidates\" array of strings or simple objects) OR - documents mode (top-level \"query\" string, \"documents\" array where each doc has \"passages\"). mixing them can confuse server-side validation.
Sana Patel: is it failing because their top-level \"query\" is an object with text key? I see \"query\": {\"text\": ...} in payload. We expect \"query\": \"...\" for rerank.
Mohammed Ali: yes—good catch. schema v1 expects query as string. We tolerate object in embeddings endpoint, but rerank validator is strict. that yields the misleading error about candidates/documents.
Cara Nguyen: customer says SDK (python) built a dict and it serialized \"query\" as {\"text\":...} automatically. reproducible with curl though. repro steps attached.
Mohammed Ali: quick repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"query": {"text":"x"}, "candidates": ["a","b"]}' returns 422. Change to '"query":"x"' and it passes.
Cara Nguyen: they also saw scores of 0 when they flattened passages into candidates (lots of very short candidates). maybe hitting token limits or scoring threshold.
Eli Torres: scoring zeros often mean the model returned scores but we normalized poorly when candidates were empty strings or duplicates. also the batch size cap (max_candidates_per_request=200) will truncate silently; downstream normalization then looks odd. check candidate count and dedupe.
Sana Patel: recommended response to customer: 1) send canonical schema example for both modes, 2) show python snippet to ensure query is string, 3) warn about mixing documents+candidates, 4) confirm candidate count under 200.
Cara Nguyen: draft reply: ```Hey — thanks for the report. Rerank accepts two shapes:
1) candidates mode:
{
  \"query\": \"your query string\",
  \"candidates\": [\"text1\",\"text2\"]
}
2) documents+passages mode (for passage-level scoring):
{
  \"query\": \"your query string\",
  \"documents\": [{\"id\":\"d1\",\"passages\":[{\"text\":\"...\"}]}]
}
Do not send both in the same request. Also ensure query is a string (not {\"text\":...}). Limit candidates to 200. Let us know the request id if you still see zeros.```
Mohammed Ali: add a small example to convert passages to candidate strings if they want simple rerank: ```candidates = [p['text'] for d in documents for p in d.get('passages',[])]```
ops-bot: Incident 3742 linked — schema-validation false positives flagged last week :rotating_light:.
Cara Nguyen: customer accepted the repro and fixed query -> string, removed documents when using candidates. still reported a couple zero scores on heavy duplicate candidates, we told them to dedupe and it's fixed.
Sana Patel: follow-up action: eng-ml to add clearer error message when query is object, and add a quick schema hint in response body. can we file a small docs PR?
Eli Torres: filing ENG ticket now (ENG-rr-521) to: tighten validation message, log more detailed validation errors, and add example payloads to docs.
Cara Nguyen: thanks all, closing loop with customer now. :white_check_mark:
